g.title: NeurOneCADParts
g.text: NeurOne — Mechanical CAD Parts Dependency Graph (2026-08-10, rev 2)
A -> B: "B depends on A" | dashed red border = PROVISIONAL | dashed grey border = RETIRED (tombstone)

g.title: cluster_modules
g.text: C. Zone Modules (universal hex-tile, current arch.)

g.title: cluster_interconnect
g.text: K. L1 Socket Interconnect (NP-DRV-SHELL-002 / NP-HW-HUB-001 Rev C) — NEW

g.title: SCALP_SCAN->SHELL_INNER
g.text: scan-grounded scalp datum offset outward defines the inner-bowl tiling surface (REG-1 basis)

g.title: SHELL_OUTER->RIM_LATCH
g.text: four-corner latch clamps outer bowl to inner bowl at the rim parting plane

g.title: SHELL_OUTER->HELMHOLTZ_FORMER
g.text: Helmholtz coil formers are co-designed as one magnetic circuit with the outer bowl's mu-metal layer

g.title: SHELL_OUTER->TMS_WINDOW
g.text: TMS window is a local non-conductive break in the outer bowl's CFRP layer

g.title: SHELL_OUTER->EEG_ROUTE_CHANNEL
g.text: RETIRED: there is no zone-module FPC bundle to route opposite, and no separate EEG harness

g.title: SHELL_OUTER->PORT_COVER_ANCHOR_SHELL
g.text: anchor post is molded adjacent to each hub port opening on the shell/hub boundary

g.title: SHELL_OUTER->HUB_HOUSING
g.text: hub-to-shell mechanical interface, cable entry, and EMI bonding depend on shell rim geometry at the occipital arch (OI-HTOOL-01, open)

g.title: SHELL_OUTER->EARCUP_HOUSING
g.text: ear-cup subassembly mounts to the outer-bowl (L3) rim at the ear cutout excluded from the tile lattice

g.title: SHELL_INNER->SOCKET_BODY
g.text: ~80-socket lattice is a molded feature array of the inner bowl

g.title: SHELL_INNER->CLUSTER_CLAMP
g.text: clamp actuator mounts on the inner bowl's outer (gap-facing) face, one per 7-hex flower

g.title: SHELL_INNER->RIM_LATCH
g.text: latch also engages the inner bowl rim (both bowls clamp together for use)

g.title: SHELL_INNER->FLUXGATE_MOUNT
g.text: fluxgate magnetometers mount on the inner bowl, near the scalp

g.title: SHELL_INNER->CLUSTER_CARRIER
g.text: carriers are LAMINATED INTO L1 - the inner bowl stops being a molded part and becomes an electro-mechanical assembly (new supplier CAT, OI-SHELL2-04)

g.title: SOCKET_BODY->BLANK_PLUG
g.text: blanking plug shares the identical hex footprint as a live module

g.title: SOCKET_BODY->SOCKET_GASKET
g.text: gasket land is co-molded to the socket rim

g.title: SOCKET_BODY->BEZEL
g.text: bezel land is molded at the socket rim, proud of optical module faces only

g.title: SOCKET_BODY->SOCKET_CONTACT
g.text: spring-contact array seats in the socket floor; pad pattern asymmetric so a mis-key fails OPEN, not wrong

g.title: SOCKET_BODY->TILE_SHELL
g.text: module footprint must mate socket cutout (40mm hex, orientation key)

g.title: BLANK_PLUG->CASE_CLAMSHELL
g.text: partial-population option (~6 concurrent tiles, ~$920 to fill 80 sockets) may put 50-60 plugs in a build - OI-HEXTILE-06 sizes both the plug tool and the packaging

g.title: BEZEL->ELECTRODE_POD
g.text: at h_b=1.0mm the bezel consumes 8% of the pod's +/-12mm one-sided travel; electrode aperture stays bezel-free (BEZEL-1b)

g.title: BEZEL->TILE_T1A
g.text: h_b sets the active field: W_a=38.0mm, A_a=12.51cm2 (+17.9% vs the 2.5mm assumption), so per-channel E falls 403->342 mW/cm2 at 150mA and needs ~176mA to reach the 400 ceiling

g.title: BEZEL->HEATSINK_ASSY
g.text: h_b sets R_gap=s/k_air: at 1.0mm (0.0385) the forced outward path (0.010-0.040) is the preferred sink; at 0.6mm (0.0231) the scalp competes - the bezel is what lets the fan do the work

g.title: CLUSTER_CLAMP->TILE_SHELL
g.text: clamp plate's spring-loaded plungers seat and retain each module in the cluster

g.title: CLUSTER_CLAMP->CLUSTER_CARRIER
g.text: MUST STAY SEPARATE PARTS on opposite faces of the same cluster footprint: if the carrier were the plate, every module swap would cycle a whole cluster's electrical connection

g.title: CLUSTER_CLAMP->CLUSTER_TAIL
g.text: no formed bend may fall under a clamp-plate footprint or under a socket, so clamp load never bears on a bend (REQ-BR2-05)

g.title: SOCKET_CONTACT->CLUSTER_CLAMP
g.text: contact count x0.3-0.5N sets clamp-plate load (18/16/14 contacts = 63/56/49N per 7-tile plate) against RISK-22 one-handed force (OI-SHELL2-03)

g.title: SOCKET_CONTACT->TILE_SHELL
g.text: tile presents a flat gold PAD ARRAY on its back face - no FPC tail, no dynamic flex anywhere in the module interconnect

g.title: RIM_LATCH->RIM_LABYRINTH
g.text: latch clamping force compresses the labyrinth lip + conductive bead seal

g.title: RIM_LATCH->BLIND_MATE_BOSS
g.text: flanking PL/PR latches seat the posterior-center blind-mate boss as bowls close

g.title: FLUXGATE_MOUNT->BLIND_MATE_BOSS
g.text: fluxgate sensor harness crosses the parting plane via the blind-mate boss

g.title: HELMHOLTZ_FORMER->BLIND_MATE_BOSS
g.text: Helmholtz coil harness crosses the parting plane via the blind-mate boss

g.title: TMS_COIL_HOUSING
g.text: CANNOT BE SIZED: TMS has NO

g.title: TMS_WINDOW->TMS_COIL_HOUSING
g.text: coil housing mates directly over the non-conductive window to avoid eddy-current field loss

g.title: EEG_ROUTE_CHANNEL->N4_GUARD_LANE
g.text: SUCCESSOR: the <5uVpp threshold survives (SH2-DRC-16); it is now met by guarding + short analog paths + deterministic artifact, not by >=15mm of geometry

g.title: PORT_COVER_ANCHOR_SHELL->PORT_COVER_HUB
g.text: tether anchor retains the port cover when detached

g.title: TEMPORAL_WING_BOSS->MASTOID_PAD_CLIP
g.text: 30mm receiver + snap-detent geometry sets the mating pad clip's required dimensions

g.title: BOA_DIAL->BOA_CABLE
g.text: replacement lace is dimensioned to the dial's channel cross-section and OD

g.title: BOA_DIAL->HUB_CHANNEL
g.text: Boa channel must continue without cross-section discontinuity from shell into hub housing

g.title: BOA_DIAL->BOA_REGREASE_KIT
g.text: regrease applicator nozzle is sized to the dial's grease port

g.title: TEMPORAL_WING->TEMPORAL_WING_BOSS
g.text: anchor boss is an integral molded feature of the temporal wing body

g.title: ELECTRODE_POD->TILE_T1B
g.text: REVERSED rev 2: the pod BODY DIAMETER (unspecified anywhere, OI-HEXTILE-05) decides how many emitter rings T1-B depopulates - 0-1/0-2/0-3 opens 7.6/15.2/22.8mm clear

g.title: TILE_SHELL->TILE_T1A
g.text: element-population variant on the shared tile mould

g.title: TILE_SHELL->TILE_T1B
g.text: element-population variant on the shared tile mould

g.title: TILE_SHELL->TILE_T1C
g.text: element-population variant on the shared tile mould

g.title: TILE_SHELL->TILE_T2D
g.text: element-population variant on the shared tile mould

g.title: TILE_SHELL->RIGIDIZER_BOARD
g.text: rigidizer cavity is a STANDARD feature of the universal mould - every tile type carries a driver (D-3), so there is no smart-module mould variant

g.title: TILE_SHELL->CASE_CLAMSHELL
g.text: case's internal cavity profile is fitted to the assembled headset + module envelope

g.title: TILE_T1A->PDMS_WINDOW_TILE
g.text: optical tile requires bonded PDMS window over LED array

g.title: PD_PAIR_TILE
g.text: PD2 co-located in XY on the

g.title: TILE_T1A->PD_PAIR_TILE
g.text: dose metering requires PD1/PD2 pair behind the window

g.title: TILE_T1B->AG_AGCL_CONTACT
g.text: electrode tile carries the dual-rated Ag/AgCl contact in place of a full LED window

g.title: TILE_T1B->PD_PAIR_TILE
g.text: electrode tile still meters its own reduced PBM population

g.title: TILE_T1B->QEEG21_CAP_ELECTRODE
g.text: qEEG-21 electrode reuses T1-B's dual-rated Ag/AgCl mechanical family at higher density

g.title: TILE_T1C->PDMS_WINDOW_TILE
g.text: optical tile requires bonded PDMS window over LED array

g.title: TILE_T1C->PD_PAIR_TILE
g.text: dose metering requires PD1/PD2 pair (InGaAs variant) behind the window

g.title: TILE_T2D->PDMS_WINDOW_TILE
g.text: optical tile requires bonded PDMS window over LED array

g.title: CLUSTER_CARRIER->SOCKET_CONTACT
g.text: carrier hosts its cluster's contact arrays; every socket must sit <=50mm from its own carrier (SH2-DRC-03) - the whole reason the analog front end moved here

g.title: CLUSTER_CARRIER->CLUSTER_TAIL
g.text: one tail per carrier, formed once at assembly

g.title: N1_BUS_PAIR
g.text: TREE from PAN, never a ring.

g.title: CLUSTER_CARRIER->N1_BUS_PAIR
g.text: cluster power gate feeds the broadside supply pair

g.title: CLUSTER_CARRIER->N4_GUARD_LANE
g.text: per-cluster analog mux drops the montage onto the shared guarded lanes

g.title: PAN
g.text: ADS1299 bank here or on the

g.title: CLUSTER_TAIL->PAN
g.text: all 18 tails converge at the occiput centreline

g.title: PAN->BLIND_MATE_BOSS
g.text: PAN is co-sited with the boss; the module interconnect SHARES the existing aperture rather than opening a second RF slot

g.title: N1_BUS_PAIR->FLUXGATE_MOUNT
g.text: the LED bus is an ELF dB/dt source on the fluxgates' own layer: cancellation calibration becomes configuration-dependent and must re-run on module-map rebuild (REQ-EMI-11)

g.title: N1_BUS_PAIR->HELMHOLTZ_FORMER
g.text: feed-forward self-field subtraction must bind to MEASURED PD/dose telemetry, not commanded current (REQ-EMI-05)

g.title: N4_GUARD_LANE->AG_AGCL_CONTACT
g.text: the one contact pair on which <=50mohm and fretting are genuinely binding - it sits in the uV EEG path (OI-HEXTILE-11)

g.title: HUB_HOUSING->PROBE_DOCK
g.text: probe dock cradle is a molded feature of the hub housing exterior

g.title: HUB_HOUSING->FAN_DOOR
g.text: access door is a molded cutout + captive-fastener bosses in the hub housing

g.title: HUB_HOUSING->SUPERCAP_MOUNT
g.text: supercap mount is an internal retention feature of the hub housing

g.title: PROBE_DOCK->PROBE_DOCK_PAD
g.text: silicone insert pad bonds into each probe-tip receptacle of the dock

g.title: FAN_DOOR->HEATSINK_ASSY
g.text: door provides tool-free clearing access to the fan/heatsink cavity behind it

g.title: HEATSINK_ASSY->SOCKET_CONTACT
g.text: and the socket contact count is blocked behind that same decision

g.title: HEATSINK_ASSY->RIGIDIZER_BOARD
g.text: whether the TIA+ADC stay on-module (D-4) is deferred pending the module heat-sink / helmet-cooling design - 42C face / 62C junction, plus ADC drift vs the +/-15% dose claim (OI-HUB-C17c)

g.title: HEATSINK_ASSY->PORT_COVER_HUB
g.text: port-cover tether length is bounded so a detached cover cannot reach the fan intake grille (FAI-HTOOL-02)

g.title: LENS_RIM->GOGGLE_ARM
g.text: sliding-rail T-slot (rim) and mating tongue (arm) are co-reviewed as one mating pair

g.title: LENS_RIM->LENS_SUBSTRATE
g.text: lens substrate seats in the lens rim's optical aperture

g.title: LENS_RIM->SHADE_S1
g.text: 6 N42 magnet pockets in the rim must align with the shade's reversed-polarity mating pockets

g.title: LENS_RIM->SHADE_S2
g.text: same magnet-pocket mating pattern as S1

g.title: LENS_RIM->SHADE_S3_CARRIER
g.text: same magnet-pocket mating pattern as S1/S2

g.title: GOGGLE_ARM->LENS_RIM
g.text: EC driver spring pins (arm) must align with EC contact pads (rim) - EC configuration only

g.title: GOGGLE_ARM->LENS_RIM_GUARD
g.text: tether anchor hook on the arm retains the rim guard, clear of the shade body and visual field

g.title: LENS_SUBSTRATE->GOGGLE_PROXIMITY
g.text: IR proximity + Hall sensor mounts are positioned relative to the substrate's eye-facing aperture

g.title: SHADE_S3_CARRIER->S3_RX_INSERT
g.text: optician-fitted insert mounts into the carrier's optical aperture

g.title: EARCUP_HOUSING->BAYONET_MOUNT
g.text: bayonet mount is an integral feature of the ear-cup housing

g.title: EARCUP_HOUSING->BONECONDUCT_ISOLATOR
g.text: isolator mounts the bone-conduction piezo element within the ear-cup housing

g.title: BAYONET_MOUNT->MESH_FRAME
g.text: mesh frame snaps into the bayonet mount

g.title: PROBE_BODY->PROBE_DOCK
g.text: dock saddle radius is sized to the Y-probe junction body OD, not the lead OD

g.title: PROBE_BODY->PROBE_DEPTH_RING
g.text: depth-stop rings are over-molded onto the probe shaft

g.title: PROBE_BODY->PROBE_TIP_SENSOR
g.text: tip sensor housing terminates each bilateral probe arm

g.title: PROBE_BODY->CASE_CLAMSHELL
g.text: case includes its own transport probe-dock cavity, distinct from the hub's active-storage dock

g.title: PROBE_TIP_SENSOR->PROBE_DOCK_PAD
g.text: dock pad geometry protects the probe-tip PD window and auth contacts in storage

g.title: PROBE_TIP_SENSOR->PROBE_SLEEVE
g.text: consumable hygiene sleeve fits over the tip sensor housing

g.title: CLIP_BODY->CLIP_HYDROGEL_INTERFACE
g.text: hydrogel pad interface geometry is molded into the clip's contact face

g.title: CLIP_BODY->CLIP_A1A2_CONTACT
g.text: A1/A2 contacts reuse 2 spare conductors already present in the clip's 6-pin cable

g.title: CVNS_NECKBAND->CVNS_GEL_ELECTRODE_HOUSING
g.text: gel electrode housings mount bilaterally on the neckband body

g.title: CABLE_USBC->HUB_HOUSING
g.text: strain-relief boot geometry mates to the hub's USB-C port opening
